overlap.rationale: Compared overlapping neutral, portal, and cold-blue emitters in the Bone Cairn and ice cavern without clipping or lost object silhouettes.

linked-depth.rationale: Compared a linked underground-city depth; the authored illumination continues to distinguish its corridor and adjacent combat space.

horizontal-boundary.rationale: Compared a horizontally linked city boundary and bridge; lighted walls, water edges, and exits remain readable in both renderer modes.

dark-interior.rationale: Compared the source lab and every glower context in both modes: warm emitting fixtures preserve deliberate darkness without wall bleed or washout, while the five zero-radius fixtures remain dark.

outdoor-transition.rationale: Compared street/interior transitions and colored-animation contexts; outdoor detail remains readable without palette clipping.

fog-roof.rationale: Compared the Bone Cairn portal under fog and occluding cave structure; lighting does not reveal blocked routes or erase the cutaway boundary.

navigation.rationale: Compared the baseline enclosed garden plus all eight glower contexts; fixture-owned illumination retains entrances, walls, and walkable routes in both renderer modes.
